_readme: Accepted SCG exceptions and manual attestations for -m13 (US-014). Each entry: control (SCG ID, wildcards allowed), objects (inventory names, wildcards; default all), type ('exception' = accepted deviation, 'attested' = a control the scripts cannot assess, verified by hand), justification (required), approved_by (the architect; entries without it are reported as not approved), expires (YYYY-MM-DD, optional), reference (story/ticket, optional). Copy this file to conf/ if you keep lab-specific approvals out of git, and point lab_spec scg.exceptions_file at it.

entries.justification: Nested ESX hosts (US-007) run as VMs on esx02 without a vTPM; TPM 2.0 cannot be provided to them.
TPM-based configuration encryption needs a TPM (see esx-9.hardware-tpm).
No TPM-based configuration encryption, so there is no recovery key to back up (see esx-9.hardware-tpm).
Nested ESX hosts boot from a remastered kickstart ISO (US-007); UEFI Secure Boot is not enabled on the nested VMs.
Depends on UEFI Secure Boot (see esx-9.hardware-secureboot).
Nested ESX hosts have no hardware management controller (BMC/iDRAC).
Temporary: Theogony -m7 --dns-ntp persists host configuration over SSH (auto-backup.sh). SSH is disabled in the final hardening pass of US-014.
